name: UGC 3755 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 3755, a dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc3755-hubble
story: A small, irregular galaxy that has been little studied. Hubble picked out its brightest red giant stars to measure how far away it is, and to test whether it belongs to a loose association of dwarf galaxies.

claims.text: UGC 3755 is a typical dwarf irregular galaxy that has been little studied
HST program 10210 used the tip of the red giant branch method with ACS to measure distances to dwarf galaxies in groups, UGC 3755 among them
UGC 3755's membership in the 14+19 association of dwarf galaxies is in doubt
